Q1.rationale: Segment 16 keeps the undertakings in force indefinitely and segments 20-21 require survival obligations for at least 24 months after the agreement ends.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 9 applies the undertakings regardless of the way or form in which information is disclosed, which covers verbal disclosure.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: The NDA does not deal with disclosure of the fact that the agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q3.label: NotMentioned

Q4.rationale: No residual knowledge or unaided memory exception appears; the NDA has only public domain and prior knowledge carve-outs.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q6.rationale: Segment 15 states that neither the agreement nor the supply of information grants any licence, interest or right in the intellectual property.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Segment 13 allows disclosure required by law but imposes no duty to notify the Discloser.
Q7.label: NotMentioned

Q8.rationale: Segment 7 limits use of the Confidential Information to the Purpose without the Discloser's written agreement.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segment 8 prohibits disclosure to any third party, which is incompatible with sharing with consultants, agents and professional advisors.
Q11.label: Contradiction

Q13.rationale: Segment 8 bars disclosure to any third party and the Recipient is an individual, so sharing with its employees is not permitted; the NDA does not address employees by name.
Q13.label: Contradiction

Q14.rationale: Segment 15 states that no interest is granted in intellectual property rights, which is incompatible with transferring ownership to the Recipient.
Q14.label: Contradiction

Q15.rationale: Segments 17 and 18 state that the receiving party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 15 grants the right to copy the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: The NDA contains no notice of immunity for confidential trade secret disclosures to government officials or attorneys.
Q17.label: NotMentioned

Q18.rationale: Segment 8 bars disclosure to any third party, and a government agency is one; the only carve-out (segment 13) covers disclosures required by law or competent authority, not voluntary reports of suspected violations.
Q18.label: Entailment

Q19.rationale: The NDA does not mention sexual harassment or sexual assault.
Q19.label: NotMentioned
